intro.text: The bridge sergeant of Bridge Eighteen in Dalinar Kholin's army.

items.text: When Kaladin assessed the bridge crews, he found Bridge Eighteen dejected and fractured, which made Vet's weakness worse. He considered spreading its men among other platoons if he couldn't help Vet motivate them.

personality.text: Earnest but socially awkward, Vet lacks an air of authority and tends to beg his men to do things rather than order them.
